title: Lead Developer – Full Stack (React.js + Node.js)
description:
Location: **Noida**


Experience: **8 to 12 Years**


No. Of Openings: **1**


  
### **Job Description**

We are looking for a hands\-on Lead Dev / Tech Lead – Full Stack to lead an engineering workstream on a large enterprise platform. The platform is a React 18 \+ TypeScript SPA backed by Node.js micro\-services on Azure over a Snowflake data platform, with Azure Event Hub and Datadog observability.


This is a senior hands\-on role — roughly 60% coding and design, 40% technical leadership, code review and direct client interaction. The person must be able to own a workstream end to end without supervision.


Key Responsibilities:


* Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of assigned workstreams across frontend (React / TypeScript) and backend (Node.js on Azure) — from requirement walkthrough to production release.
* Translate business requirements from client product owners into technical designs, break them into sprint\-ready tasks and estimate them.
* Act as the review gate for the team: pull\-request reviews, enforcing coding guidelines, modular and scalable design, and low code complexity.
* Remain hands\-on — personally write production code for the hardest parts of each sprint.
* Design and build REST APIs on Azure (App Service or Azure Functions; the platform runs on Functions v4 with Node 22\) integrating Snowflake, Event Hub and third\-party systems.
* Mentor and grow a team of 4–6 developers; run onboarding and knowledge transfer for new joiners.
* Represent Impressico on client technical calls in US Eastern hours — daily connects, sprint demos, design walkthroughs and production\-issue calls — and hold technical credibility with the client architects.
* Work with DevOps and QA on Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, release readiness and production support; drive application errors and performance issues to closure using Datadog.
* Own technical documentation — architecture notes, API documentation and runbooks.


### **Job Specification**


8–12 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a lead or senior capacity on enterprise\-grade products.


* Deep hands\-on React.js (18\+) with TypeScript — hooks, component design, state management, re\-render and bundle performance optimisation. TanStack / React Query experience strongly preferred.
* Deep hands\-on Node.js — JavaScript / TypeScript, REST API design, async patterns, error handling, performance and memory behaviour.
* Hands\-on Microsoft Azure — building and deploying services on Azure App Service and/or Azure Functions, Azure DevOps pipelines, Entra ID / Azure AD authentication (MSAL), Key Vault and App Configuration.
* Strong SQL and data modelling — able to write and tune complex queries and stored procedures (Snowflake, SQL Server or Oracle).
* Solid software design grounding — modular and scalable architecture, low cyclomatic complexity.
* Git branching strategy, CI/CD and code review practised as a discipline.
* Unit\-testing discipline (Vitest / Jest on the JS stack, equivalent on the backend).
* Excellent spoken and written English — able to run technical discussions with US\-based stakeholders independently.
* Agile / Scrum delivery — sprint planning, estimation, demos.
* Use of AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor).


### **Required Key Skills**

**Good to have**


* Event\-driven architecture on Azure.
* Working experience using Snowflake (pooled connections, stored procedures, warehouse cost awareness).
* Observability tooling — Datadog RUM / APM and structured logging, or equivalent (App Insights, ELK).
* API gateway exposure — Apigee or Azure API Management.
* Vite\-based build tooling and modular / feature\-first frontend architecture.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular + Java)
description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.
We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high\-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.
Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier\-one investment banks and many of the largest buy\-side firms globally.
Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers will work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production
### **What You’ll Be Doing**

* Partnering with our client to lead the design and build of user experiences using modern web development technologies. You will manage a team of UI engineers and collaborate with key contributors to deliver high\-quality software within client environments.
* Contribute to the Interactive Practice within Lab49 by sharing best practices and driving a culture of high\-quality UI engineering and modern development standards.
* Act as a hands\-on engineer and architect supporting initiatives from small features to complex systems. Lead projects, mentor teams, and collaborate with other practices to ensure successful delivery.
* Design and build full\-stack applications using Angular (primary) and Java technologies (secondary), ensuring scalable architecture, efficient APIs, and seamless integration between front\-end and backend services.
* Support backend development using Java (e.g., Spring/Spring Boot) to build and maintain RESTful services, business logic, and integrations with enterprise systems and databases.
* Partner with client stakeholders to build strong relationships, acting as a strategic technical advisor and helping expand long\-term engagements.
* Support business development efforts through solution design, client presentations, and contributing to proposals and industry engagement.
* Help develop strong management practices within the Engineering practice, supporting career growth and mentoring across the team.
### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop responsive web applications using Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.
* Build backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
* Design and integrate RESTful APIs with frontend components.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in an Agile environment.
* Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews and CI/CD processes.
### **Required Skills**

* 8\+ years of software development experience.
* Strong expertise in Angular (v10\+)
* Backend development experience with Java / Spring Boot.
* Experience with REST APIs, Git, and modern development practices.
### **Preferred**

* Experience with microservices, AWS and Terraform.
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes and containerized deployments.
* Experience in capital markets, financial markets/products, consulting is highly desirable.
* Experience with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot is a plus.
Why Lab49?

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49\. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.
Lab49/ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.
Lab49/ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.

*We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
